description: This file defines build configurations and package details for glibc locale data in a Yocto/OpenEmbedded build environment, including dependencies, package groups, locale generation options, and installation procedures.

methods.name: copy_locale_files
methods.description: Copies locale files from source directory to build directory with specified permissions.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs locale files into the build output directories, handling gconv and other locale data.
